hodgkin.d: English physiologist who, with Andrew Huxley, discovered the role of potassium and sodium atoms in the transmission of the nerve impulse (1914-1998)

hod.d: an open box attached to a long pole handle; bricks or mortar are carried on the shoulder

hodeida.d: an important port in Yemen on the Red Sea

hodoscope.d: (physics) scientific instrument that traces the path of a charged particle

hodman.d: a laborer who carries supplies to masons or bricklayers
